strings.狼群局部搜索比例: Fraction of wolves doing local search
strings.种群规模，越大探索越充分但每代越慢: Population size: larger explores more thoroughly but each generation is slower
strings.保留旧速度前缀的比例，大=延续惯性，小=更听两个最优的: Fraction of the old velocity prefix kept: large = keep momentum, small = follow the two bests more
strings.向自己历史最优靠近的强度: How strongly a particle is pulled towards its own best
strings.向全局最优靠近的强度: How strongly a particle is pulled towards the global best
strings.每代每个粒子做小预算 2-opt 的概率；0=关闭（纯 PSO）: Probability that each particle does a small-budget 2-opt each generation; 0 = off (pure PSO)
strings.每次局部搜索最多接受几次 2-opt 移动: Maximum number of 2-opt moves accepted per local search
strings.每 N 代对全局最优集中改进一次；0=关闭: Intensively improve the global best every N generations; 0 = off
strings.集中改进时最多接受的 2-opt 移动数: Maximum number of 2-opt moves accepted during the intensive improvement
strings.nn=从最近邻构造出发（推荐），random=纯随机排列（教学对照）: nn = start from a nearest-neighbour construction (recommended), random = pure random permutation (teaching contrast)
strings.每代并行构造解的蚂蚁数量: Number of ants constructing solutions in parallel each generation
strings.信息素浓度的相对重要度；0=纯贪心按距离走: Relative importance of the pheromone level; 0 = purely greedy by distance
strings.距离启发式的相对重要度；越大越贪心: Relative importance of the distance heuristic; larger is greedier
strings.每代信息素蒸发比例；太大遗忘快，太小收敛慢: Fraction of pheromone evaporating each generation; too large forgets fast, too small converges slowly
strings.每条路径释放的信息素总量: Total pheromone deposited by each tour
strings.全局最优路径额外释放信息素的次数；0=关闭精英策略: Extra deposits of pheromone by the global-best tour; 0 = elitist strategy off
strings.每个城市只考虑最近的 k 个邻居（性能关键）: Each city only considers its k nearest neighbours (performance-critical)
strings.每 N 代对全局最优做一次 2-opt（ACS 标准操作）；0=关闭: Apply 2-opt to the global best every N generations (standard ACS operation); 0 = off
strings.每次局部搜索最多接受的 2-opt 移动数: Maximum number of 2-opt moves accepted per local search
strings.蜜源=雇佣蜂=观察蜂数量: Number of food sources = employed bees = onlooker bees
strings.蜜源连续多少代无改进就被侦察蜂重置；太小浪费好解，太大跳不出局部最优: How many generations without improvement before a scout resets a source; too small wastes good solutions, too large cannot escape local optima
strings.邻域搜索用片段逆转的概率，否则交换两点: Probability that the neighbourhood move reverses a segment; otherwise two points are swapped
strings.每 N 代对全局最优做一次 2-opt 并回灌种群；0=关闭: Apply 2-opt to the global best every N generations and feed it back into the population; 0 = off
strings.大=只有近邻互相吸引（局部搜索强），小=全局互相吸引: Large = only near neighbours attract each other (stronger local search), small = global mutual attraction
strings.每萤火虫每代做一次随机扰动的概率: Probability that each firefly makes a random perturbation each generation
strings.每次 α 扰动包含的随机 2-opt 试射次数（越大局部搜索越强）: Number of random 2-opt trial shots in each α perturbation (more = stronger local search)
strings.单次向亮者移动的最大交换比例: Maximum swap fraction per move towards a brighter firefly
strings.每 N 代对最亮萤火虫做一次 2-opt 并回灌；0=关闭: Apply 2-opt to the brightest firefly every N generations and feed it back; 0 = off
strings.气泡网螺旋的形状；大=螺旋更展开: Shape of the bubble-net spiral; large = wider spiral
strings.每头鲸每代随机交换两城市的概率: Probability that each whale swaps two cities at random each generation
strings.单次包围/螺旋的最大交换比例: Maximum swap fraction per encircling / spiral move
strings.每 N 代对最优做一次 2-opt 并回灌种群；0=关闭: Apply 2-opt to the best every N generations and feed it back into the population; 0 = off
strings.一对亲代发生 OX 交叉的概率: Probability that a pair of parents undergoes OX crossover
strings.每个子代发生反转变异的概率: Probability that each offspring undergoes reversal mutation
strings.每代直接复制到下一代的最优个体数: Number of best individuals copied directly to the next generation
strings.每次选择随机抽几个个体、取其中最优；越大选择压力越强: How many individuals are drawn per selection, taking the best; larger means stronger selection pressure
strings.nn=多起点最近邻播种（推荐），random=纯随机排列（教学对照）: nn = multi-start nearest-neighbour seeding (recommended), random = pure random permutation (teaching contrast)
strings.0=自动（取初始解平均边长）；越大初期越容易接受劣解: 0 = automatic (mean edge length of the initial solution); larger accepts worse solutions more easily at the start
strings.每代温度乘以 α；越接近 1 降温越慢、搜索越充分: The temperature is multiplied by α each generation; the closer to 1, the slower the cooling and the more thorough the search
strings.每个温度下尝试多少次邻域移动；0=自动（=城市数）: How many neighbourhood moves are tried at each temperature; 0 = automatic (= number of cities)
strings.每 N 代对 α 做一次完整 2-opt 并回灌种群；0=关闭: Apply a full 2-opt to alpha every N generations and feed it back into the population; 0 = off
strings.每次头狼改进最多接受的 2-opt 移动数: Maximum number of 2-opt moves accepted per alpha improvement
strings.每匹狼每代随机交换两城市的概率（防停滞）: Probability that each wolf swaps two cities at random each generation (prevents stagnation)
strings.单代向单头狼靠近的最大比例；超过 0.6 会种群坍塌: Maximum fraction of approach to a single wolf per generation; above 0.6 the population collapses
strings.每代多大比例的狼做轻量 2-opt；0=关闭（纯 GWO）: Fraction of wolves doing a light 2-opt each generation; 0 = off (pure GWO)
strings.每次轻量局部搜索随机尝试多少个 2-opt 移动: How many random 2-opt moves each light local search tries
strings.一个移动被执行后被禁忌的代数；太短原地打转，太长搜索受限: How many generations a move stays tabu after being made; too short and the search circles, too long and it is over-restricted
strings.每代随机采样多少个候选移动再挑最好的: How many candidate moves are sampled at random each generation before picking the best
strings.种群大小（大实例自动降配）: Population size (reduced automatically on large instances)
strings.差分变异的步长比例；太小收敛慢，太大不收敛: Step-size proportion of the differential mutation; too small converges slowly, too large does not converge
strings.变异体与父代做 OX 交叉的概率；排列域上建议 0.2 左右（交叉破坏性强，见实: Probability that the mutant is OX-crossed with the parent; about 0.2 is recommended in the permutation domain (crossover is highly disruptive, see the implementation comments)
strings.单次差分变异执行交换前缀的最大比例: Maximum fraction of the swap prefix executed in one differential mutation
strings.每个个体每代随机交换两城市的概率: Probability that each individual swaps two cities at random each generation
strings.对每个新 trial 做短 2-opt 试射的概率（memetic DE 组件）: Probability of a short 2-opt trial on each new trial vector (memetic DE component)
strings.每次打磨包含的随机 2-opt 试射次数: Number of random 2-opt trial shots per polishing
strings.每 N 代对全局最优做一次 2-opt 并回灌；0=关闭: Apply 2-opt to the global best every N generations and feed it back; 0 = off
strings.每代被随机发现并重新播种的最差鸟窝比例: Fraction of the worst nests discovered at random and re-seeded each generation
strings.莱维飞行的整体步长基数: Overall base step length of the Lévy flight
strings.越小步长分布越重尾（偶发大步越频繁）: Smaller means a heavier-tailed step distribution (occasional big steps are more frequent)
strings.振荡幅度的初值，线性衰减到 0: Initial oscillation amplitude, decaying linearly to 0
strings.每个体每代随机交换两城市的概率: Probability that each individual swaps two cities at random each generation
strings.单次振荡执行交换前缀的最大比例: Maximum fraction of the swap prefix executed in one oscillation
strings.进攻阶段触发莱维俯冲（短 2-opt 试射）的概率: Probability of triggering a Lévy dive (short 2-opt trial) in the attack phase
strings.每只鹰每代随机交换两城市的概率: Probability that each hawk swaps two cities at random each generation
strings.单次包围移动执行交换前缀的最大比例: Maximum fraction of the swap prefix executed in one encircling move
strings.每次扰动连踢几脚双桥（越多踢得越远）: How many double-bridge kicks per perturbation (more kicks go farther)
strings.每次下探最多执行的 2-opt 移动数: Maximum number of 2-opt moves per descent
strings.扰动后比当前差时怎么办: What to do when the perturbed solution is worse than the current one
strings.restart 模式：连续 N 代无改进就从最近邻重新构造: restart mode: after N consecutive generations without improvement, rebuild from nearest neighbour
strings.shake 邻域的层数（越大探索越远）: Number of shake neighbourhood levels (larger explores farther)
strings.第二层邻域摘下重插的连续城市段长上限: Maximum length of the city segment removed and reinserted by the second-level neighbourhood
strings.单次 pass 最多链式执行几次交换（变深度搜索的核心参数）: Maximum number of chained exchanges in one pass (the core parameter of variable-depth search)
strings.每步抽样的候选断裂点数（越大越精细越慢）: Number of candidate break points sampled per step (larger is finer but slower)
strings.每 N 代无改进就踢一脚双桥跳出局部盆地；0=关闭: Kick a double bridge after N generations without improvement to leave the local basin; 0 = off
strings.种群规模（大实例自动降配）: Population size (reduced automatically on large instances)
strings.向最优移动的最小步幅基数: Minimum base step towards the best
strings.向最优移动的最大步幅基数（防种群坍塌）: Maximum base step towards the best (prevents population collapse)
strings.随机游走（2-opt 试射）的初始强度: Initial strength of the random walk (2-opt trial shots)
strings.在最优解附近做定位性开发的概率: Probability of local exploitation near the best solution
strings.蝙蝠找到更好解后响度乘以 α（逐步收敛到开发）: After a bat finds a better solution its loudness is multiplied by α (gradually shifting to exploitation)
strings.蝙蝠找到更好解后脉冲率按 γ·r 增长: After a bat finds a better solution its pulse rate grows by γ·r
strings.和声记忆库 HM 的容量: Capacity of the harmony memory HM
strings.新和声从记忆库取材的概率；否则完全即兴（重新构造）: Probability that a new harmony draws from memory; otherwise it is fully improvised (reconstructed)
strings.抄完记忆和声后做微调（2-opt 试射/逆转）的概率: Probability of fine-tuning (2-opt trial / reversal) after copying a remembered harmony
strings.移动步幅基数（向引力源执行的交换序列比例）: Base step size (fraction of the swap sequence executed towards the attractor)
strings.G(t)=G0·decay^t；越快收敛越早、探索越少: G(t) = G0·decay^t; faster decay converges earlier with less exploration
strings.每个天体每代随机交换两城市的概率（速度残差的等价物）: Probability that each body swaps two cities at random each generation (the equivalent of velocity residue)
strings.对当前位置直接做短 2-opt 试射的概率（memetic GSA 组件）: Probability of a short 2-opt trial directly at the current position (memetic GSA component)
strings.班级规模（大实例自动降配）: Class size (reduced automatically on large instances)
strings.学习阶段用 OX 交叉（重组）vs 交换序列（模仿）的比例: Share of OX crossover (recombination) versus swap sequences (imitation) in the learner phase
strings.对每个新解做短 2-opt 试射的概率（memetic TLBO 组件）: Probability of a short 2-opt trial on each new solution (memetic TLBO component)
strings.方向好时最多连游几步（swim 深度）: Maximum swim steps while the direction stays good (swim depth)
strings.每代最差个体被随机迁移重播的概率: Probability that the worst individuals are randomly migrated and re-seeded each generation
strings.越大绕火焰的弧线越弯（探索越强）: Larger makes the arc around the flame more curved (stronger exploration)
strings.对当前位置直接做短 2-opt 试射的概率（memetic MFO 组件）: Probability of a short 2-opt trial directly at the current position (memetic MFO component)
strings.每代炸出的火花总数基准（按适应度分配给各烟花）: Base total number of sparks per generation (distributed among fireworks by fitness)
strings.单个火花最多做几次突变；越大勘探越远: Maximum mutations per spark; larger explores farther
strings.觅食行为每代尝试的邻域移动次数；太小勘探不足: Neighbourhood moves tried by the foraging behaviour each generation; too small under-explores
strings.每代随机观察的同伴数: Number of companions observed at random each generation
strings.视野内更优鱼占比超过 δ 就放弃追尾/聚群；越小越怕挤: Give up following / swarming when the fraction of better fish in view exceeds δ; smaller is more crowd-averse
strings.向同伴移动时执行交换序列前缀的最大比例: Maximum fraction of the swap-sequence prefix executed when moving towards a companion
strings.每代从分布抽样的解数量（大实例自动降配）: Number of solutions sampled from the distribution each generation (reduced automatically on large instances)
strings.前百分之多少的样本算精英；太小学得太快易早熟: Top percentage of samples counted as elite; too small learns too fast and converges prematurely
strings.分布更新保留旧分布的比例；越大收敛越稳越慢: Fraction of the old distribution kept at each update; larger is steadier and slower
strings.对精英样本做短 2-opt 试射再回写分布的概率: Probability of a short 2-opt trial on elite samples before writing back to the distribution
strings.前 PD 的麻雀负责勘探觅食；原文建议 0.2: The top PD fraction of sparrows scout for food; the original paper suggests 0.2
strings.从加入者中随机抽取负责警戒的个体: Individuals drawn at random from the joiners to act as scouts
strings.警戒值 R2 < ST 时全群安心觅食，否则收缩回撤；越大越少恐慌: When the alarm value R2 < ST the whole flock forages calmly, otherwise it contracts and retreats; larger means less panic
strings.加入者向全局最优移动的交换前缀最大比例: Maximum swap-prefix fraction of joiners moving towards the global best
strings.蚂蚁与蚁狮一一配对（大实例自动降配）: Ants and ant lions are paired one to one (reduced automatically on large instances)
strings.坑最深时一段游走走几步；随迭代线性收缩到 1: Steps of a walk when the pit is deepest; shrinks linearly to 1 over the iterations
strings.游走中被坑壁滑向中心时交换前缀的最大比例: Maximum swap-prefix fraction when sliding along the pit wall towards the centre during the walk
strings.r < p 时向最优蝴蝶移动（全局搜索），否则局部搜索；原文建议 0.8: When r < p move towards the best butterfly (global search), otherwise search locally; the original paper suggests 0.8
strings.香味 = 归一化适应度的 a 次幂；越大好蝴蝶越少动: Fragrance = normalised fitness to the power a; larger means good butterflies move less
strings.总人口（大实例自动降配）: Total population (reduced automatically on large instances)
strings.初期帝国主义者数量，会随帝国崩溃减少: Initial number of imperialists; decreases as empires collapse
strings.殖民地向宗主国移动的比例系数（原文 β∈(0,2)，越大同化越猛）: Proportional coefficient for colonies moving towards the imperialist (β ∈ (0, 2) in the original; larger assimilates more aggressively)
strings.每个殖民地每代发生政变的概率；0=关闭（会明显变差）: Probability of a coup in each colony each generation; 0 = off (results get clearly worse)
strings.链长（大实例自动降配）: Chain length (reduced automatically on large instances)
strings.总种群（大实例自动降配）: Total population (reduced automatically on large instances)
strings.memeplex 数量，每群约 n_pop/n_mem 只: Number of memeplexes, about n_pop / n_mem frogs each
strings.每 N 代重新排序分组一次: Re-sort and regroup every N generations
strings.全局/局部授粉切换概率 p（原文推荐 0.8）: Global / local pollination switch probability p (the original recommends 0.8)
strings.被偷者察觉的概率（越大越难偷）: Probability that the owner notices (larger makes stealing harder)
strings.偷窃时向记忆点移动的比例上限: Upper bound on the fraction moved towards the memory point when stealing
strings.每个栖息地每代被随机修改的概率: Probability that each habitat is randomly modified each generation
strings.每步从最近 k 个候选随机选；k=2 是实测甜区，越大构造越烂: Each step picks at random among the k nearest candidates; k = 2 is the measured sweet spot, larger makes the construction worse
strings.每次落点允许的 2-opt 移动数上限: Maximum number of 2-opt moves allowed at each landing point
strings.每代注入的随机新抗体个数（多样性）: Number of random new antibodies injected each generation (diversity)
strings.原质团个体数量（大实例自动降配）: Number of plasmodium individuals (reduced automatically on large instances)
strings.传播波随机重新铺开的概率；越大勘探越猛: Probability that the propagation wave re-spreads at random; larger explores more aggressively
strings.随机键空间的初始探索半径；越大起步越莽撞: Initial exploration radius in random-key space; larger starts more recklessly
strings.每对父代做交叉的概率: Probability that each pair of parents is crossed
strings.直接进入下一代的父代最优个数: Number of best parents passed directly to the next generation
strings.k 越大选择压力越强: Larger k gives stronger selection pressure
strings.每 N 代触发一次局部搜索；0=关闭: Trigger local search every N generations; 0 = off
strings.局部搜索的最大移动数（fixopt 配方 = 每代采样窗口数）: Maximum number of local-search moves (for the fixopt recipe = sampling windows per generation)
strings.连续 N 代无改进即停；0=只按迭代预算停: Stop after N consecutive generations without improvement; 0 = stop only on the iteration budget
strings.每代只有代理预测最优的前 N 个子代付真实评估: Each generation only the N offspring the surrogate predicts best get a real evaluation
strings.行为描述子每维分格数；总格数 = N²: Grid cells per behaviour-descriptor dimension; total cells = N²
